{"python_snippet": "from oracle import *
import torch
kernel, reference = load_task()
import itertools
for red in ["none","sum","mean","batchmean"]:
  for dt in [(torch.float32,torch.float32),(torch.bfloat16,torch.float32),(torch.float32,torch.bfloat16)]:
    for shape in [(3,7),(2,20000),(4,70000)]:
      torch.manual_seed(0)
      p=torch.randn(shape).to(dt[0]).requires_grad_(); q=torch.randn(shape).to(dt[1])
      q[0,:3]=p[0,:3].detach().to(dt[1]) 
      sl=torch.tensor([1,-100,5,2][:shape[0]])
      p2=p.detach().double().requires_grad_()
      out=kernel(p,q,sl,red); r=reference(p2,q.double(),sl,red)
      up=torch.randn(out.shape) *3
      out.backward(up); r.backward(up.double())
      print(red,dt,shape,(out.double()-r).abs().max().item()/(r.abs().max().item()), (p.grad.double()-p2.grad).abs().max().item()/p2.grad.abs().max().item())
"}

      sl=torch.tensor([ii,1,ii,3,0][:shape[0]])
      p2=p.detach().double().requires_grad_()
      try:
        r=reference(p2,q.double(),sl,red)
      except Exception as e: print('skip');continue
      out=kernel(p,q,sl,red)
      up=torch.randn(out.shape) *3
      out.backward(up); r.backward(up.double())
      print(ii,red,shape,(out.double()-r).abs().max().item()/(r.abs().max().item()), (p.grad.double()-p2.grad).abs().max().item()/p2.grad.abs().max().item())
